chapterInfo.content:
13
Sɔhwɛ ho asotwe
1 # Deut 19.15; 1 Ti 5.19 Mprɛnsa ni a mereba mo nkyɛn. Adansefoɔ baanu anaa baasa ano asɛm biara bɛgyina. 2Mebɔɔ wɔn a wɔyɛɛ bɔne kane no ne wɔn a aka no nyinaa kɔkɔ, saa ara nso na seesei a menni mo nkyɛn yi merebɔ wɔn kɔkɔ, sɛdeɛ meyɛeɛ berɛ a mebaa hɔ ne mprenu soɔ no, sɛ meba bio a, meremfa wɔn ho nkyɛ wɔn. 3Ɛfiri sɛ mohwehwɛ Kristo a ɔkasa me mu no ho adansedie, ɔno na ɔnyɛ mmerɛ wɔ mo fam, na mmom ɔwɔ mo mu tumi. 4#Flp 2.7-8 Na mmerɛyɛ mu na wɔbɔɔ no asɛnnua mu deɛ, nanso ɔnam Nyankopɔn tumi so te ase. Na yɛn nso yɛyɛ mmerɛ wɔ ne mu deɛ, nanso yɛn ne no nam Nyankopɔn tumi so bɛtena ase wɔ mo fam.
Hwɛ wo ho yie adeɛ baako a ɛhia ho
5 # 1 Ko 11.28 Monsɔ mo ho nhwɛ sɛ mowɔ gyidie no mu anaa? Mommisa mo ho nhwɛ! Anaasɛ monnim mo ho sɛ Yesu Kristo te mo mu? Gye sɛ mommfata deɛ. 6Na m’ani da so sɛ mobɛhunu sɛ yɛn deɛ, yɛnyɛ nnipa a wɔmfata. 7Nanso yɛbɔ Onyankopɔn mpaeɛ sɛ monnyɛ bɔne biara, ɛnyɛ sɛ wɔbɛhu yɛn sɛ yɛfata, na mmom mo, mobɛyɛ deɛ ɛyɛ fɛ, na yɛn deɛ yɛayɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔmfata. 8Na yɛntumi nyɛ hwee ntia nokorɛ no, na mmom deɛ yɛtumi yɛ no, yɛyɛ ma nokorɛ. 9Na sɛ yɛyɛ mmerɛ, na mo deɛ, moyɛ den a, yɛn ani gye; na mo pɛyɛ ho na yɛbɔ mpaeɛ. 10#2 Ko 10.11; 10.8 Yei nti na, menni mo nkyɛn yi, meretwerɛ yei mabrɛ mo, na sɛ meba a, mene mo anni no denden, sɛdeɛ tumi a Awurade de ama me sɛ ɛmma nkɔsoɔ na ɛnyɛ ɔsɛeɛ no teɛ no.
Awieeɛ
11 # Flp 4.4; Rom 15.32 Afei awieeɛ, anuanom, makra mo. Monyɛ pɛ, momma mo werɛ nkyekye, monnya adwene korɔ, montena asomdwoeɛ mu, na ɔdɔ ne asomdwoeɛ Nyankopɔn bɛdi mo akyi. 12#1 Ko 16.20 Momfa mfeano kronkron nkyeakyea mo ho. 13Ahotefoɔ no nyinaa kyeakyea mo. 14#Rom 16.20 Awurade Yesu Kristo adom, Onyankopɔn dɔ ne Honhom Kronkron ayɔnkofa nka mo nyinaa.

pageProps.chapterText:
Mprɛnsa ni a mereba mo nkyɛn. Adansefoɔ baanu anaa baasa ano asɛm biara bɛgyina. Mebɔɔ wɔn a wɔyɛɛ bɔne kane no ne wɔn a aka no nyinaa kɔkɔ, saa ara nso na seesei a menni mo nkyɛn yi merebɔ wɔn kɔkɔ, sɛdeɛ meyɛeɛ berɛ a mebaa hɔ ne mprenu soɔ no, sɛ meba bio a, meremfa wɔn ho nkyɛ wɔn. Ɛfiri sɛ mohwehwɛ Kristo a ɔkasa me mu no ho adansedie, ɔno na ɔnyɛ mmerɛ wɔ mo fam, na mmom ɔwɔ mo mu tumi. Na mmerɛyɛ mu na wɔbɔɔ no asɛnnua mu deɛ, nanso ɔnam Nyankopɔn tumi so te ase. Na yɛn nso yɛyɛ mmerɛ wɔ ne mu deɛ, nanso yɛn ne no nam Nyankopɔn tumi so bɛtena ase wɔ mo fam.

Monsɔ mo ho nhwɛ sɛ mowɔ gyidie no mu anaa? Mommisa mo ho nhwɛ! Anaasɛ monnim mo ho sɛ Yesu Kristo te mo mu? Gye sɛ mommfata deɛ. Na m’ani da so sɛ mobɛhunu sɛ yɛn deɛ, yɛnyɛ nnipa a wɔmfata. Nanso yɛbɔ Onyankopɔn mpaeɛ sɛ monnyɛ bɔne biara, ɛnyɛ sɛ wɔbɛhu yɛn sɛ yɛfata, na mmom mo, mobɛyɛ deɛ ɛyɛ fɛ, na yɛn deɛ yɛayɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔmfata. Na yɛntumi nyɛ hwee ntia nokorɛ no, na mmom deɛ yɛtumi yɛ no, yɛyɛ ma nokorɛ. Na sɛ yɛyɛ mmerɛ, na mo deɛ, moyɛ den a, yɛn ani gye; na mo pɛyɛ ho na yɛbɔ mpaeɛ. Yei nti na, menni mo nkyɛn yi, meretwerɛ yei mabrɛ mo, na sɛ meba a, mene mo anni no denden, sɛdeɛ tumi a Awurade de ama me sɛ ɛmma nkɔsoɔ na ɛnyɛ ɔsɛeɛ no teɛ no.

Afei awieeɛ, anuanom, makra mo. Monyɛ pɛ, momma mo werɛ nkyekye, monnya adwene korɔ, montena asomdwoeɛ mu, na ɔdɔ ne asomdwoeɛ Nyankopɔn bɛdi mo akyi. Momfa mfeano kronkron nkyeakyea mo ho. Ahotefoɔ no nyinaa kyeakyea mo. Awurade Yesu Kristo adom, Onyankopɔn dɔ ne Honhom Kronkron ayɔnkofa nka mo nyinaa.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
